name: cache-keeper
description: Band with usage left, prompt-cache state and idle compaction status, a cold-send guard, optional keepwarm, and an optional auto compact before an idle session's cache goes cold.

autoCompact.title: Auto compact fallback
autoCompact.description: cache-keeper's own idle compaction, off by default: compact once when the session idles, before the cache goes cold. For sessions where Claude Code's idle compaction does not run.

compactAfter.title: Auto compact after idle
compactAfter.description: Idle time before the fallback compacts: auto is 55m on a 1h cache (5m before cold) and 4m on a 5m cache.

guard.title: Cold-send guard
guard.description: Before a message that re-writes a large cold cache: ask, log the estimate, or do nothing.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: The cache lifetime this session runs on: 1h on included subscription usage, 5m on most API-key sessions.

minTokens.title: Large-context floor
minTokens.description: Context size, in tokens, below which neither auto compact nor the guard acts.
